title: Laddu, Chintu and Golu's Animal Sound Band
moral: Your own voice is special, so be proud to be you.
description: Tonight is the Animal Sound Band show at the Masti Nagar Mela, and Golu the goat wants to join! But Golu only knows one sound, so Laddu and Chintu try to teach him to quack, moo and woof. Learn what ducks, cows, dogs and goats say in this funny animated story about being yourself, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Good morning, Masti Nagar! Guess what? Tonight is the big Animal Sound Band show at the Mela!
Everyone in the band makes a real animal sound. And Golu the goat wants to join SO much!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Yes! A goat says BAA! Can you say it with Golu? Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Hmm. But Golu knows only ONE sound. A band needs lots of sounds... and lots of jalebis!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! We'll teach Golu ALL the animal sounds! It's a plan... a slightly wobbly plan!

narration.text: First stop, the lotus pond! Three white ducks were paddling about. What does a duck say?
QUACK, QUACK! Yes! A duck says quack! You're so smart!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Watch me, Golu! Waddle, waddle... QUACK! QUACK! Quaaa...
Chintu waddled so hard, his glasses slid down his nose... and SPLOOSH! One foot went right into the pond!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-quack-a-a!
Hee hee! That was half a goat and half a duck!

narration.text: Next, they trotted to the chai stall. A big friendly cow was munching grass. Now YOU tell me. What does a cow say?
MOOOO! Wah, you're so clever!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Moo means... more jalebis, please! Right?
No, Laddu! Moo is just a cow's way of saying hello!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-moo-a-a!
Uh-oh. Golu's moo came out all wibbly-wobbly!

narration.text: At the busy market, a puppy wagged his tail. WOOF, WOOF! A dog says woof!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! Laddu, hold Golu still. I'll bark like a puppy! Woof! Woof!
Laddu pulled this way. Golu pulled that way. And then... BONK!
Ka-BOING! All three tumbled into a giggly pile of cabbages!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-woof-a-a?
Quack, moo, woof. Three tries, three mix-ups. And Golu's ears drooped down, down, down.

narration.text: That evening, Golu sat all alone under the big banyan tree. He wasn't even hungry!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Why is Golu so sad? Leave it to Pinky! FWEEEET!
Pinky's whistle was so loud, three parrots tumbled off the branch. Plop, plop, plop!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: We kept asking Golu to quack and moo and woof. We never said his own sound was good.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Golu, I'm sorry. Your Ba-a-a-a is the best sound in Masti Nagar!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.text: That night, the Mela glowed with lamps. And Dadaji was the band leader!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Ready, band? Cow first!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: MOOOOO!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: QUACK, QUACK!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Wonderful! Now for the great big ending... the big... zzzzz...

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Huh? I'm awake! I was just... resting my eyes!

narration.text: But the song still needed a great big ending. Who could do it?

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Leave it to Pinky! FWEEEET!
Up hopped Golu, his bell going jingle, jingle!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: BA-A-A-A-A-A!
It was the loudest, happiest BAA in the whole world! Everybody clapped and danced!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Wah! Nobody says baa better than Golu!

narration.text: Let's remember! What does a duck say?
QUACK! Super!
And what does a cow say?
MOO! Wow!
And a dog says woof, and a goat says BAA! You know all the animal sounds!

narration.text: After the show, Golu took a happy bow. He was proud to be just Golu!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Your own voice is special. Be proud to be you!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah, jalebi time! Golu, can you say jalebi?

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
And then... CHOMP! Golu gobbled Laddu's jalebi in one big bite!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Golu! That was MY jalebi! Hee hee hee!
